name: fam-03-write
prompt: Verify Store.Delete in session.go is idempotent: deleting an unknown or already-deleted id is a silent no-op (no error, no state change). Pin it with TestDeleteIdempotent in session_test.go: delete twice, delete an unknown id, assert no panic and Len unchanged.
check:
grep -F -q 'func TestDeleteIdempotent' session_test.go || { echo 'precursor change missing' >&2; exit 1; }
go build ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
